description: This file defines a configuration class for FireworksAI's text completion, including methods to support OpenAI parameters, map parameters, and transform text completion requests.

classes.name: FireworksAITextCompletionConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Fireworks AI's text completion system, inheriting mixin and base configuration functionalities.

methods.description: Maps non-default parameters into optional parameters for OpenAI requests, filtering supported params.

methods.description: Transforms input messages into a prompt and prepares the data payload for a text completion request.
